## Bug Description

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

A clear and concise description of what actually happened, including any error
messages, stack traces, or screenshots.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.4, Ubuntu 22.04, Windows 11]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 20.11.0]
- Package version / commit: [e.g. 1.2.3 / abcdef0]
- Browser (if applicable): [e.g. Chrome 124]

## Severity / Priority

> Use a priority keyword in the body so the automation can classify this issue:
> `critical`, `urgent`, `production`, `outage` (critical) ·
> `important`, `high`, `blocking` (high) ·
> `medium`, `normal` (medium) ·
> `low`, `nice-to-have`, `minor` (low)

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here (logs, links, related issues, etc.).
